slides.title: Rights commission confirms 48 killed in Shirka
people killed on Oct 24, the EHRC confirms
slides.body: 23 local security personnel, 5 militia members and 13 civilians, plus 7 civilians killed by informal armed individuals.

slides.title: families displaced, the commission says
slides.body: It also counted 20 people injured and 21 homes burned in Birbona Chole kebele.

slides.title: people detained, Oromia's government says
slides.body: EHRC says the attackers identified as the OLA. Residents say some detainees had no role; this is unverified.

slides.title: Independent investigation. Protection for every civilian.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica, Nov 4, 2026
